capability: Online store and its theme (Shopify: Online Store, Themes and templates; Salla: Store design, تصميم واجهة المتجر, اختيار ثيم المتجر)
note: The root of the storefront tree. Shopify's Online Store section (admin navigation OnlineStore, route online-store) and Salla's Store design (/themes, dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-themes) each hold the store's theme, its editor, the theme market and, on Salla, the landing pages. "Online store" names the whole storefront on Shopify; Salla has no separate term for it, its plan line تصميم واجهة المتجر names the storefront's design.

capability: Theme editor and theme code (Shopify: theme editor, Edit code, Liquid, write_theme_code; Salla: themes editor, تخصيص الثيم عبر CSS و JS, Twilight Engine)
note: Customizing the published theme without code (editor) and with code (Shopify's Liquid and Edit code; Salla's CSS and JS customization and Twilight themes). Both platforms put it under the theme section: Shopify's staff permission "Online store > Edit code" and route editor; Salla's /themes/editor.

capability: Theme marketplace (Shopify: Theme Store; Salla: Theme Marketplace / متجر الثيمات)
note: Where merchants find and buy themes made by designers or developers, and where those makers publish them. Shopify's Theme Store; Salla's Theme Marketplace (/themes/marketplace) and its partners' theme publication. Salla's partner side (SA-C-208) lands in batch 2.

capability: App extensions in the storefront (Shopify: theme app extensions, app embeds, app proxies, script tags; Salla: App Snippets)
note: How an installed app adds its own elements or code to the merchant's storefront. Shopify: "Theme app extensions allow merchants to easily add dynamic elements to their themes" (SH-S-0705); Salla: "App Snippet lets you extend any merchant store with custom JavaScript" (SA-S-0209). Under CM-SFR-001 because Shopify's statement puts it in the theme.

capability: Storefront design elements beyond the theme (Shopify: Store design apps; Salla: Component Bundle)
note: Elements added to the storefront's design besides the theme itself: Shopify's App Store category Store design apps (page builders, content, design elements, media, banners, pop-ups, product display, site optimization); Salla's component bundles published in its Theme Marketplace. Shopify's SEO apps sit in that category too; SEO is area CNT and its cell is left to that batch.

capability: Landing pages and page builders (Shopify: Page builder apps; Salla: Landing pages / صفحات هبوط المنتج)
note: Pages built outside the theme's templates for a product or a campaign. Salla builds them itself (/themes/landing-pages); Shopify's statements show only the App Store category Page builder apps. The join is on role, a reading. Salla's plan places صفحات هبوط المنتج under أدوات التسويق (adoat-altsoyk) and its admin under themes.

capability: Storefront announcement bars, banners and pop-ups (Shopify: Banner apps, Pop-up apps; Salla: Advertisements / شريط إعلاني أعلى المتجر)
note: A bar, banner or pop-up shown across the storefront. Salla builds a top bar itself (Advertisements, under /marketing); Shopify's statements show only the App Store categories Banner apps and Pop-up apps under Store design apps. The parent follows Shopify's grouping; Salla's admin puts Advertisements under marketing (SA-S-3536). "Advertisements" on Salla is not Salla Ads (إعلانات سلة, SA-C-073), its ad-campaign product.

capability: Store domains (Shopify: Domains, Custom domain name; Salla: Domain, حجز دومين خاص)
note: The store's own domain name: buying one through the platform, connecting or transferring one from another provider, and the platform's default domain. Joined by Q1's match M-017. Salla's Partners-portal domains (SA-C-301) land in batch 2.

capability: DNS records for the store domain (Salla: DNS Records, إدارة إعدادات DNS)
note: Managing the DNS records of the store's domain from the platform. Salla gives it an API group (DNS Records), an access scope (dns-records) and a plan line under its domain feature. Shopify's statements hold nothing under the terms searched, and don't define it.

capability: SSL certificate for the store's domains (Shopify: Free SSL certificate, sslEnabled; Salla: شهادة SSL مجانية)
note: The store's domains served over an SSL certificate. Under CM-SFR-008 because both platforms put the SSL certificate with the domain: Salla's plan line شهادة SSL مجانية has parent_code domyn-almtgr (SA-S-2038), Shopify's sslEnabled is a field of Domain (SH-S-7465). Hosting of the store is G's CM-OPS-003, where Shopify's plan row Unlimited web hosting (SH-S-7032) is core; it was here with SSL because Shopify's concern holds both, and is moved out so it counts once (the coordinator, after batch 1).

capability: Headless and custom storefronts (Shopify: Headless, Hydrogen, Oxygen, Build headless storefronts)
note: A storefront the merchant or a developer builds apart from the platform's themes, on the platform's commerce data. Shopify gives it admin routes (headless, hydrogen), a plan line and its own hosting (Oxygen).

capability: Storefront API (Shopify: Storefront API; Salla: Store APIs, storefront APIs)
note: The buyer-facing API a storefront calls for products, cart, customers and content. Under CM-SFR-011 by Shopify's grouping, whose headless concern holds it (Headless channel or custom app, SH-S-6152); on Salla the storefront APIs are called by Twilight themes through the Twilight JS SDK (SA-S-5140), so Salla's grouping differs: see notes. Salla's SA-C-101 lands in batch 2 (M-056).

capability: Storefront search and filtering (Shopify: Search, Filters, read_discovery; Salla: Product filter settings, إدارة خيارات التصفية الظاهرة للعميل)
note: The buyer's search and the product filters shown on the storefront. Salla's filters sit in its products concern SA-C-020 (domain B, naming E under also).

capability: Files (Shopify: Files, Content > Files)
note: The store's library of uploaded files. Shopify gives it a place of its own: admin navigation Files under Content (SH-S-1525), the route file:list gated by VIEW_FILES (SH-S-5122), the scopes read_files and write_files. No Salla statement found names a store-wide file library (searched; see the Salla cell).

capability: Custom data: metafields and metaobjects (Shopify: Metafields and metaobjects, custom data)
note: Merchant-defined fields and objects on the store's data. Shopify gives it a settings page (Metafields and metaobjects, SH-S-1500), admin navigation Metaobjects, scopes, webhook topics and staff permissions. Salla's custom fields (product custom fields, SA-C-020; order custom fields, SA-C-042) are not joined: neither side defines its term, and the terms differ (Q1's U-005; see the notes).

capability: Store pages (Shopify: Pages, Blog posts and pages; Salla: Information pages, الصفحات التعريفية)
note: Pages of content on the storefront. Shopify's grouping holds the blog under pages: the staff permission Online store > Blog posts and pages (SH-I-0991), the PAGES permission on the blog's comments route (SH-S-5124), and the scope read_online_store_pages on article events (SH-S-6062). Salla's grouping differs: information pages at /channel/pages (SA-S-1831), the blog at /blog and /marketing/blog (SA-S-1698, SA-S-3555). The parent follows Shopify's, the one grouping that joins them.

capability: Store blog (Shopify: Blog, Blog posts; Salla: Blog, مدونة المتجر)
note: A blog of posts on the storefront. Shopify: Blog posts in Content (SH-S-1527), the Article and Blog resources. Salla: Blog (/blog, SA-S-1698), its settings, plan line and staff permissions. Under CM-CNT-003 by Shopify's grouping (see CM-CNT-003's note); Salla puts its blog under marketing.

capability: Navigation menus (Shopify: Menus; Salla: store-menu)
note: The storefront's navigation menus. Shopify: Menus in Content (SH-S-1526), gated by LINKS (SH-S-5123), scopes read and write_online_store_navigation. Salla: the released dashboard flag store-menu (SA-S-3343). Shopify's URL redirects, in its concern SH-C-031, have no statement of their own (see the notes).

capability: Custom URLs (Salla: Custom URLs, روابط مخصصة)
note: Salla's Custom URLs: an admin link (/manage/custom-urls), an API folder, a plan line and a staff permission. No statement defines what a custom URL is. Not joined with Shopify's URL redirects: Q1's M-015 note says the terms differ, and Shopify's redirects have no statement of their own.

capability: SEO (Salla: SEO, تحسين ظهور المتجر على محركات البحث; Shopify: SEO apps)
note: Optimizing the store for search engines. Salla builds it (SEO at /marketing/seo, an API folder, plan lines, flags and staff permissions) and has an app category Site Optimization; Shopify's statements show only the App Store category SEO apps (SH-I-1934, an entry Q1 placed in SH-C-193, landed in CM-SFR-005).

capability: Store policies (Shopify: Policies, Store policies; Salla: information pages for the store's policies, سياساتك)
note: The store's published policies (refund, return, shipping, terms). Shopify: Settings > Policies (SH-S-7087), gated by MANAGE_POLICIES and the policies entitlement. Salla: no policies section; its information pages carry the policies (SA-S-2100), and one is marked as the return and exchange policy page (SA-S-5034). A join on role. A root by Shopify's grouping (Settings, not Content); on Salla the policies are information pages (CM-CNT-003).

capability: Sales channels and publishing to them (Shopify: Sales channels, publications; Salla: Sales channels / قنوات البيع, product.publish)
note: Q1's M-054. Both platforms give it an admin place of its own: Shopify's Sales channels (SH-S-1534, SH-S-1496), Salla's Sales channels (/channels, SA-S-1687). Its children are the channels and channel tools the platforms put under it (see notes).

capability: The platform's own shopping app or marketplace for buyers (Shopify: Shop, Shop App; Salla: Mahally / منصة محلي)
note: A join on role (U-053): Shop, "a shopping destination ... available to customers" (SH-S-0723), against Mahally, "a discovery and sales channel connected to Salla merchants" (SA-S-0005). Parent: Shopify's help puts Shop under online-sales-channels (SH-S-0723's identifier); Salla's plan puts منصة محلي under its sales-channels group knoat-albyaa (SA-S-2067).

capability: Connecting external marketplaces and syncing their orders (Shopify: Marketplace Connect, marketplace orders; Salla: الربط بمنصات التسوّق العالمية)
note: A join on role (U-054). Parent: Shopify's help puts Marketplace Connect under online-sales-channels/marketplaces (SH-S-0727's identifier); Salla's plan line is in its sales channels concern (SA-C-097).

capability: Product listings and feeds for channels (Shopify: Listings, product_listings, product_feeds; Salla: google-merchant-feed, facebook-catalog-feed, snapchat-catalog-feed)
note: Q1's M-055 holds Shopify's feeds with pixels and events (domain D); scope.tsv places SH-C-138 here apart from it. A root: no held statement puts listings or feeds under sales channels on either platform; Salla's feed flags sit in its Pixels & feeds concern (SA-C-074, domain D, under marketing).

capability: Selling and sourcing products between the platform's stores (Shopify: Shopify Collective)
note: Shopify's alone so far: its plan row Sell and source products with Shopify Collective (SH-S-7013). Parent: Shopify's help puts it under online-sales-channels (SH-S-0729's identifier). Domain B's CM-CAT-010 (product sourcing) also cites SH-S-0729 and SH-S-7013 as core.

capability: The store's own branded mobile app (Shopify: Mobile app builder apps, mobile platform applications; Salla: App Maker / صانع التطبيقات, Mobile app)
note: Q1's M-078: built in on Salla, through apps on Shopify. Parent by Salla's grouping: route /channel/mobile (SA-S-1837) and the plan line صانع التطبيقات under knoat-albyaa (SA-S-2068); Shopify's statements show no grouping for it.
